data.name: VerificationSubject
data.value: Verify your email address for Ecnanib

data.name: VerificationBody
data.value:
Someone created an Ecnanib account with this address, or asked to verify it.
To verify it, open this link while you're signed in to that account:
{0}
The link works once, until {1:u}.
If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Nobody can verify the address without the link.
data.comment: {0} is the link. {1} is when it expires, in UTC.

data.name: PasswordResetBody
data.value:
Someone asked to reset the password of the Ecnanib account that uses this address.
To choose a new password, open this link:
{0}
The link works once, until {1:u}. Resetting signs out every device that's signed in to the account.
If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
data.comment: {0} is the link. {1} is when it expires, in UTC.
